[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained a '''Starfighter Division''' that researched and developed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. One of the division's projects was the study of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of unknown origin found underneath [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] ice spires.
